text.text_excerpt: I got to experience Roulaison though a Yelp Elite event and it was nothing short of amazing. Patrick and Andrew (owners) have an enthusiastic spirit that's obviously poured into their craft. Roulaison is a small yet super cool rum distillery that sits between a Cidery and Chocolatier and just moments from Xavier University and Carrollton Ave. Rum has such a cool history and to see the distilling process was simply fascinating. Roulaison offers a variety of rum at different proofs and "flavors" which we were able to sample. Definitely stop by for a tour if you're in town or if you're local, it's truly a cool experience!

I was lucky enough to go on a private tour on a Saturday afternoon with a few friends. Co-owner Andrew was our guide and he did a fantastic job telling us all about the rum making process and explained everything in an easy-to-understand manner. Roulaison is a small and new rum distilling company and, I'll be honest, I know nothing about liquor production. Everything here is handcrafted and it's all local. All of this was pretty new to me, but I found the tour very interesting and Andrew was extremely nice and was happy to answer questions. After the tour came the tasting and I'm not a liquor drinker, so this got real interesting. I can usually handle liquor if it's mixed with something, ...

So I love love Roulaison! I have had the great opportunity to try their rums in cider and cocktails! It is phenomenal and truly delicious! I recently visited the location and there was $4 tasting! Can you believe it! The owners broke down their distilling process and discussed each of the 4 rum selections for us. Every selection was smooth and perfection. You pretty much can taste the herbs and I just love them for that! Check it out for a short tasting. There is street and lot parking!
